CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
2
"Fraction" used for "Faction" throughout.
Duplicated blocks: Minara's-Era provinces/capitals (twice), Aicruae
wildlife/crops (twice), Cidet 3 overlapping entries), "Political Fractions" (twice).
Spelling: "House Yuera" vs "House Yurea"; "loose canon" vs "loose cannon."
🟡  Not fully thought out
Knights missing from the job-economy % breakdown (sums to 100% without
them).
All Crandona's-Era capitals TBD; Aicruae Military + in-template Religion
sections blank.
"48% of the world's eggs/berries/rice/peaches from the Aoner" — very
high, sanity-check.
❓  Questions
House Orana Sevtor's house) cross-referenced but not among the 13 houses
or any faction — Aicruan? Vikitsv magic house?
Mount "Aicren" Vikitsv) shares a root with "Aicruae" — intentional?
Miuae = "third most valued" currency — which two outrank it?
🕰  Timeline
🔴  Conflicts
The era gap (most important). Solis 7,250 BR, Crandona 050 AR, Minara
2,632 AR = a 7,250-yr gap between Books 1 and 3 9,900 yrs across all four),
yet the same noble houses are treated as continuous. Needs an in-world
explanation or a date fix.
Saints predate their religion: Saint Aliirusk dies 18,740 BR but the Circle of
Eternal Light is "founded" 14,271 BR (self-flagged).
Magic Tower lineage spans only 23 generations for what should be
centuries; unclear how it relates to Sevtor of House Orana.
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
3
🟠  Errors
Broken placeholder links in the Book 1 timeline; Books 14 timelines are empty
templates.
Battle of Aishae 8,704 BR listed out of order among 8,100s entries.
Open inline notes: "fix the queen name" Massacre of Light), "clarify
Yujari/Taverlo" Little Hill).
🟡  Not fully thought out
Era Overview table all blank Start/End for every era).
"Second moon raised; 13th month Agarisono) established" Date TBD — a
second moon is a major cosmological event tied to princess "moon" honorifics;
should be dated.
"Soli" (god) vs "Solis" (emperor) naming collision — confirm readers won't
conflate them.
❓  Questions
Reron is "the twelfth and final saint" but only 9 are named — are the rest
defined?
Solisian Academy Tarmet vs Academy Island (near Civer/Atriki) — same
school or two?
👑  Historical Figures
🔴  Conflicts / date & genealogy errors
Son born before the wedding: King Ilaem Nefest Patton I dated 8,734 BR, but
parents Benjaien & Vala marry 8,732 BR.
Impossible childbearing ages: Queen Cawiloan (b. 8,730 BR) mothering
Haliour II (b. 8,672 & Asayera (b. 8,674 = 5658 at birth.
Sayero Walica Patton has two date sets: 8,6088,533 BR vs 8,6158,540 BR.
Karinoa death year: 8,561 BR (header) vs 8,570 BR Legacy.
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
4
Teravian age miscalc: "died 8,577 BR at age 79" but 8,646 → 8,577  69;
Appearance also describes a child.
Walica regency length: "six years, took power at 24" vs dates 8,7368,731 BR
5 years, age 23.
🟡  / ❓  Structural
"1516 generations" Hailour I →  Solis can't be right: 1,540 yrs ≈  5060
generations; family tree also has a 1,000-yr undocumented gap 8,459 BR →
7,408 BR.
Why is Solis the "rightful heir"? He's the illegitimate son (of Lady Emillea
Hige) while Orcus & Iris are Queen Mihai's legitimate children, yet they're called
"usurpers."
20-yr succession gap: King Benjamin Lawerence Patton II dies 7,241 BR, but
the succession war is 7,2217,217 BR — who ruled between?
🎭  In Story Characters
🔴  Conflicts / ❓  Questions
War of Gods II referenced ("child Vapaz killed during War of Gods II") but the
Timeline only documents War of Gods I 30,000 BR — add II or correct to I.
Minara's parentage unclear: reads as Vandrea's biological daughter (ordered
executed for being female; Vandrea sought a male heir) yet also "reincarnation of
Soli & Apharia's daughter" — clarify blood vs. reincarnated soul.
Minara's magic = "Gnati division (uncontrolled/raw)" — cross-check
division name against Magic System.
Vandrea's "10,000 years of hatred" is the only bridge across the era gap —
confirm her timeline math matches the BR/AR dates.
🟡  Not fully thought out
Only 3 characters have any content Minara, Vandrea, Renedin), and even
those have every structured field blank — all substance is in NOTES. Major
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
5
players Soli/Leranoan, Apharia, the Emperor, Siadou Gonia) have no entries.
🟠  Errors / cleanup
Template artifacts in the body: stray 一, ==, $$, a 啨 character, empty ##
headings, lone - bullets.
Three duplicate empty "MAIN CHARACTER NAME" templates trail the page.
✨  Magic System
🔴  Conflicts
What % of people have magic? (headline). Three Stages says magic users =
"80% of the population, 344M." Paosu section says magic has "40%
inheritance chance," most people are non-magical, and Paosu are "the silent
majority." 80% vs minority — pick one canonical number.
"40% inheritance" used two ways: Takar proved 40% chance of inheriting
a parent's magical level; Paosu section reuses it as the odds of having any magic
at all. Separate the two claims.
Verna's dates: "existed more than twenty thousand years ago" vs "founded
Vikistv in 7,945 BR" 10,500 yrs before Minara). Conflict with Timeline.
Sevtor's lineage: here = descendant of Verna's eldest son "Liaerto I";
Timeline = Ulian →  Kiear & Liaerto III, current Grand Sorcerer is Kiear's child.
Reconcile.
Utayer overlaps its sub-divisions: defined as fire/water/earth/air, yet Daseri
Fire, Haliver Water, Kari (wind) are separate divisions (self-flagged twice on
the page).
🟢  Resolves earlier questions
House Orana explained — it's the Vikitsv pure-blood magic line descended
from Verna (the Magic Tower family), not an Aicruae house. Surviving member
Mekean →  Equateiy →  leads to Merigen Bleelack. Closes the Locations "House
Orana" question.)
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
6
Nellebrie confirmed a goddess (disaster/renewal) — but tied to Mount Aicren
here, not Rewqo; Rewqo association still needs a look.
Magic-timing flag softens: magic was integrated via intermarriage under
Goteivati III, not "introduced." Reword the Locations note rather than treat as a
timeline break.
🟡  Not fully thought out
All 10 division pages are near-empty templates HOW IT WORKS, LEVELS OF
MASTERY, % of Users blank), despite the intro giving Makito 60% / Rusti 40%.
Template artifacts throughout: stray $$, 一, □, LL, ー, D SII SIII, an
\xlongequal symbol, an orphaned code block in the "MAGIC DIVISION NAME"
template.
Demon ranking stated twice ("OFFICIAL RANKING" then "DEMON
CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM") — consolidate.
"Verna's 27 sons married their 15 sisters" — lopsided numbers + full-sibling
incest stated matter-of-factly; may want context.
❓  Questions
"People of the Mountain" / "People of the Sky" (ancestral magic peoples
whose mix produces Gnati) referenced but undefined here — covered in Key
Words/Religion?
Minara "communicating with demons" via Gnati — established in the outlines
or new here?
Harnua Kulio's execution Date TBD] in Timeline) can likely be set to 7,214
BR (when she poisoned Esterica).
💬  Quote Bank
🔴  Conflicts / structural reveals to reconcile
Vandrea & Apharia are sisters Book 2 Enyokia, Vandrea, Apharia Asleleri).
The Book 4 villain and Soli's dead wife (whose child Minara reincarnates) are
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
7
siblings — not stated on In Story Characters or Timeline. Is Vandrea's revenge
rooted in Apharia's murder? Make it explicit.
Apharia "mortal" vs Vandrea "10,000-yr lifespan" as sisters — needs
explanation (different fathers? transformed? partly divine?.
Renedin's monologue rewrites the cosmology — Soli = Paxtino (god of
rebirth, manifestation of Noirta, creator of world portals); twin half Ekhasostio;
Renedin fathered Soli via the grieving "lesser god" Zopha; Renedin corrupted
Vandrea; gods die permanently (no reincarnation). None of this is on the
Timeline's War of Gods entry; reflect it in Religion/Timeline, and reconcile "gods
vanish" with the Pertari Stairs afterlife.
War of Gods I vs II again — Vapaz kills Soli's wife & child here (undated); In
Story says "War of Gods II," Timeline only has I.
🟠  Errors / cleanup
Symbol legend broken/unused: key lists ★, two different - entries, ◯;
quotes use a different inconsistent set ([◁/•], [↔/•], [↓/o], [•/○], [⊙]) rendered
as raw LaTeX. Pick one consistent legend.
Typos inside quotable lines: "manifastion," "you're silly childish" ( →  your),
"favorbly him not of me," "stop be delusional," "I'I know."
Trailing \xlongequal artifact at the bottom.
🟡  Not fully thought out
Books 2 & 3 have no quotes (just "Continue format)" placeholders).
All thematic buckets empty Revenge, Family, Power, Faith, Love, Cycles);
Promotional Picks, Tagline Candidates, Prose Moments, "Quotes to Write" all
blank.
Most Book 1/4 quotes still have TBD] chapters/speakers.
❓  Questions
Prophecy: "When the Eclipsing Sun and the False Star meet, the old god shall
shatter the world." Eclipsing Sun = Minara, old god = Renedin — who is the False
Star?
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
8
Esterica's "fate like that of the previous queen" — who is the previous
queen, and what happened to her?
🔑  Key Words and Terms
🟢This page is the Canon's "answer key" — it resolves several earlier flags
(see below). It's also the most duplication-heavy page.
🟢  Resolves earlier flags
Era gap bridged: Vandrea & sisters Asleleri) are daughters of City Lord Ceval
Asleleri of Torad, who dies in Solis's conquest of Vikistv 7,217 BR. Book 2
Solis's era; Vandrea persists to Minara's era 2,632 AR ≈  9,850 yrs ≈  "10,000
years of hatred." Math works.
People of Sky/Mountain defined Fall of the Lesser Gods, 28,490 BR —
closes Magic System question.
War of Gods II is canonical here — so the Timeline is what's missing it (not an
error in In Story Characters).
Harnua's execution = 7,214 BR — fills the Timeline Date TBD.
20-yr succession gap explained: Benjamin II names Solis heir, dies 7,241 BR
→  twins' coup →  Solis 20 yrs in exile as "Janrano/Jonathan Kiva" →  returns for
civil war 7,2217,217 BR.
Yujari/Taverlo Timeline open note) fully explained in Little Hill/Bears entry.
Soli's parentage: child of goddess Zopha Vapaz's sister →  why Vapaz
spared him), secretly fathered by Renedin (per Quote Bank).
🔴  New conflicts
Twelve vs Thirteen Saints (systemic): here Harnua = "13th & final Saint"
(months table lists 13; Timeline says Reron = "12th & final"; Code Names cite
"Twelve Saints." Likely fix: 12 honored + Harnua as disgraced 13th — make explicit
and fix Timeline.
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
9
"Twelve gods" but only 11 named: 7 New Gods (weekdays) + 4 Old Gods
Renedin, Mikani, Poaranji, Haxenylian) = 11. Who is the 12th?
Nerai contradiction: an elixir "Queen Mihai is noted as drinking" vs a deadly
neurotoxin Joyless Death, "kills almost instantly"). Two things sharing a name, or
an error?
Sevtor's lineage conflict deepens: Magic Tower entry repeats Ulian →  Kiear
& Liaerto III; Magic System says Sevtor descends from Verna's eldest son "Liaerto
I."
Two near-identical king names: King Benjaien Nefest Patton 8,700s BR) vs
King Benjamin Lawerence Patton II 7,241 BR — different people 3,500 yrs
apart.
🟠  Errors / cleanup
Heavy duplication: Pataoiut 2 + restated in "BR"), Matsiali 2, Sun-Forged
2, Ilkai 3, Rern 2, Warriors' Age 2, Weekdays 2, Battle of Little
Hill/Bears 2, Pekna(s) 2), Code of Esa 2, Nerai 2.
Eternal Signs section broken: "Thirteen Eternal Signs" followed by lone "1" +
empty dividers; references signs Baerin, Garisono) not listed.
Typos: "Pireayena," "Grand Sorceer," "COQARDICE, STUPIDY/IGNORGANCE,"
"Posion," sentence cut off at "toward he," missing close-parens on Festival of the
Moon dates.
🟡  Not fully thought out / structural
Catch-all dumping ground: full cuisine menus, dance steps, Liazen genealogy
+ Isalian's jewelry collections live here — most belongs on Material Culture /
Fashion / Noble Houses. Consider migrating.
Subpage "Emperor Goteivati's Ten Rules" hangs off the bottom — not yet
audited.
❓  Questions
Who is the 12th god?
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
10
Why did Harnua raise the second moon "in Orcus's honor"? Fits if she was
an Orcus loyalist — confirm intentional.)
"False Star" (prophecy) still undefined.
⛩  Religion
🟢The cosmology bible — closes a stack of earlier flags (below), with a
few new dating conflicts.
🟢  Resolves earlier flags
"12th god" found: Zyrazithia lists the Pantheon of Twelve = the New Gods
Vapaz, Zopha, Razar, Allan, Sielaph, Nellebrie, Paha, Nimlye, Iswan, Finore,
Paxtino, Ekhasostio). Weekdays honor only 7 of 12.
Saint count settled: 13, Harnua final. So the Timeline's "Reron = 12th & final"
is the error to fix.
Second moon dated: Harnua raised it 7,214 BR "in Orcus's honor" (she loved
him) — closes Timeline Date TBD + "why Orcus."
Minara's parentage resolved: biologically the Emperor's firstborn Macenja
ordered her killed for being female); spiritually the reincarnation of Soli &
Apharia's daughter; raised by Siadou Gonia (= reincarnation of Enyokia).
"Macenja" IS Vandrea (identity theft via Renedin's shapeshifting; alive 10,000 yrs
as a corrupted soul, not a reincarnation). Closes In Story Characters + Quote Bank
flags.
Three sisters' arc closes: Enyokia ( → Siadou), Vandrea ( → Macenja), Apharia
( → dead) reunite in the great emptiness.
War of Gods II is canon Soli+Apharia union triggers it) — Timeline must add
it.
🔴  New conflicts
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
11
Twin gods' fatherhood contradicts Quote Bank: here Paxtino/Ekhasostio are
stated as fact to be fatherless (born of Zopha's tears); Renedin's monologue
reveals he secretly fathered them. Likely intentional twist — frame the fatherless
origin as "the myth mortals believe" (like Allan's concealed parentage), not fact.
Gherci founded before its founder's birth: Saint Duri "incorporated lands into
Gherci in 8,763 BR" but was born 8,747 BR (d. 8,670, age 77.
Pireaynea religion conflict: listed here as a Circle of Eternal Light country;
Key Words/Locations say it's monotheistic Allan only).
Brotherhood founding math: "6,000 years after the gods of old's defeat,"
but War of Gods I 30,000 BR →  founded 9,360 BR = 20,000-yr gap.
War of Gods II dating circular: Twin Gods entry calls 7,2007,100 BR "the
post-WoG II era," yet that's when Soli meets Apharia — the union that triggers
WoG II.
Massacre of Light leader: Religion says King Viake; Timeline note says "fix
the queen name." Reconcile.
🟠  Errors / cleanup
Harnua has two full saint entries with different epithets ("The Infamous

names — all six. Lists Aicruae → Lajazer, Gherci → Tarmet, Pireaynea → Civer,
Coelum → Atriki, Equateiy → Ociyaran, Vikitsv → Berlailia, but the page's own Name
Evolution chain says those are the Minara kingdom names with different capitals
Vellin, Bela, Lorne, Elgan, Zada, Zemela). Perfect 6-for-6 match = wrong-era
names filled into the capital field. Root of the Lajazer/Vellin tangle.
Coelum firmly "northern" here Henem Bay north of Coelum; Fetora Sea south,
shared by Vikitsv/Pireaynea/Aicruae — Coelum not listed; text: "impoverished
northern wasteland"). Conflicts with Locations placing Minara-era Atriki in the
south on the Fetora Sea.
Civil-war dates now have three values: 7,2227,217 (this page), 7,2217,217
Historical Figures), 7,2507,217 (map subpage title).
🟡  Not fully thought out
Duplicate canon: embeds a near-verbatim copy of the standalone Name
Evolution page — two master copies of the same chain = drift risk.
Population scale: Gherci 389M vs Aicruae 120M / Equateiy 97M / Pireaynea
67M / Vikitsv 46M  Gherci 3× the next; sanity-check.
Era map images linked but hub is otherwise just this one mega-doc.
❓  Question / cleanup
Internal working note leaked into canon: "Confirmed by Vicky as reasonable"
sits in the corrections log — a process note, not lore.
Heavy ASCII-art dividers ( ═══ ) and monospace blocks read as scratch
formatting, not a finished page.
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
29
🗣  Language
🟢Short page mapping languages to kingdoms + two Kurti
alphabet/number images.
🟢  Good
Clear mapping: Aicruae = Ananara (script Kurti, 26 letters); Gherci & Coelum =
Speail; Pireaynea = Pocorki; Vikitsv = Traer/Jal'vae/Dorrena; Equateiy = Audru +
Lato Lato as "romantic" fits the Venice/Italic template).
🔴  Conflicts
"Dorrena = combination of Kurti and Audru" mixes a writing system Kurti
with a spoken language Audru — category error; the other blends Traer,
Jal'vae) combine two spoken languages. Kurti's spoken counterpart is Ananara.
No divine language "Asata" on the dedicated Language page, though it's
referenced elsewhere as the gods' tongue — a gap.
Coelum shares Speail with Gherci, yet Material Culture pairs Coelum with
Norse/Scottish and Gherci with Anatolian/Ethiopian — far-flung pairing needs
justification.
🟠  Errors / cleanup
Kingdom spelled "Vikistv" here vs "Vikitsv" on Maps — reconfirms systemic
spelling split for the kingdom name.
Typos: "there written language" (their), "language of the wales" (whales),
"Coleum" Coelum, "Alpahebt" caption Alphabet), "plug on numbers," "If wanted
to create" (missing you).
🟡  Not fully thought out
Only Kurti has a documented alphabet + number system; the other seven
languages have no script, sample, or grammar — heavily Aicruae-centric.
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
30
⛩  Religion — 2nd hub (The Gods + The
Saints)
🔴SEPARATE Religion page from the main cosmology bible — a parallel
"The Gods" + "The Saints" hub with diverging lore. Two full Religion
hubs now coexist in the Canon.
🟢  Resolves / cross-confirms
12 New Gods roster matches the main Religion Pantheon of Twelve; 4 Old
Gods Mikiani/Mikani, Poaranji, Renedin, Haxenylian + minor Loart) consistent.
Identifies the Battle of Relirian: Saint Reron ("ender of worlds") died there
7,402 BR) leaving no survivors — explains Maps' note that Gherci's 78% female
population is "a legacy of the Battle of Relirian."
Confirms each saint's patron god Aliirusk ← Finore, Bura ← Vapaz,
Galamma ← Sielaph, Dorthargel ← Nellebrie, Eren ← Nimlye, Argellon ← Paha,
Siriande ← Zopha, Nairan ← Allan, Malign ← Finore, Duri ← Allan, Reron ← Vapaz) —
detail the main page lacks.
🔴  Conflicts
TWO competing War of the Gods myths. Here: four brother-gods born "of the
same song"; Haxenylian loves human Gaialana, fathers Zopha & Vapaz, Renedin
murders Gaialana, new gods win, Vapaz becomes first king — Renedin is just one
of four brothers. Quote Bank/Crown of Glory cast Renedin as the master-villain
(provoked WoG I, co-created twins, had Vapaz kill Apharia, secretly fathered Soli).
Pick one cosmology.
THIRD version of the twins' fatherhood: here Zopha is "married to Loart" and
Zopha = Paxtino + Ekhasostio Loart implied father). Main Religion = fatherless
Zopha's tears); Quote Bank/Crown of Glory = secretly Renedin. Three accounts.
Saint count: this page backs "12, Reron last" — documents only 12 saints,
ends at "12. Reron," omits Harnua (though it calls Bura "second of thirteen"). This
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
31
is the source of the Timeline's "Reron 12th & final" that conflicts with Key
Words/Religion's "Harnua 13th & final."
Gherci founded-before-founder reconfirmed: Saint Duri "founded, created,
and ruled" Gherci but is dated 8,7478,670 BR while Gherci's founding is 8,763 BR
— 16 yrs before her birth.
Vapaz is half-human (son of Haxenylian + mortal Gaialana) yet enacts the First
Divine Law banning mortal–immortal unions — the king of the gods is a product of
what he outlaws.
🟠  Errors / cleanup
Saint numbering off by one: "Malign the ninth saint" sits at list position 10
(after 9. Karniode); ordinals vs positions disagree.
Name drift on one page: "Mikiani" (vs Mikani elsewhere); "Nimyle" vs "Nimlye"
in the same section.
Nearly all god portraits are broken image embeds; Gods page is mostly empty
galleries with little text per deity.
🟡  Not fully thought out
Two full Religion hubs coexist (cosmology bible vs this Gods+Saints hub) with
diverging lore — biggest consolidation risk found. Designate one canonical,
merge/retire the other.
This Saints page has no month associations Key Words/Religion do) and no
Harnua, so neither Religion page is independently complete.
📜  Subpages: Goteivati's Ten Rules & Book2 Characters
🟢"Emperor Goteivati's Ten Rules" (under Key Words) is a strong in-world
decree. "A Tale of Three Sisters Characters" (under the Three Sisters
book page) is completely empty.
CANON AUDIT  — T racking Doc
32
⚖  Goteivati's Ten Rules — strong page
🟢  Cross-confirms threads: Article III defines the calendar reset BR  Before
Reconstruction, AR  After Reconstruction); Article II = abolition of old faiths;
Articles IV & VI = the patriarchal turn Pataoiut); Article VII = registration of magic
users ("known to the state and bound to its needs").
🔴  Reinforces the epoch-name conflict: brands the 0 AR epoch the
"Reconstruction" (matches A Princess in Love) vs Era's Reference's "Dark Ages /
Restoration." Strong evidence to settle the canonical epoch name as
Reconstruction.
🟠  Emperor's name misspelled twice on his own decree: "Goteivati Zivc
Patton III" vs "Goteivati Zivic Patton III"; plus "regin" →  reign.
🟡  Filed under Key Words and never names "Pataoiut" or "Matsiali," so a
reader can't connect the Ten Rules to that system. Cross-reference to Religion /
Era's Reference.
🎭  "A Tale of Three Sisters Characters" — empty
🟡  Completely blank (no title, no content). Book 2's character roster is an
empty placeholder; the Asleleri sisters & Book-2 cast have no profile page —
detail lives only in the Three Sisters book-info NOTES.
⚠Note: the Locations and Historical Figures pages are very long and were
only partially reviewed so far Pireaynea/Coelum/Equateiy/Vikitsv
country entries and the later Solis-era bios still pending a deeper pass).

entries.title: Canon Hyper Focused Audit
entries.text:
🔍
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
⚙Methodology. This audit cross-checks named entities (people, houses,
locations, factions, events, objects, terms) across the CANON hub, its
subpages, the WWG hub, and its subpages. Findings quote the source
text and name the page each fact came from. Nothing here is invented
— gaps and ambiguities are flagged, not filled.
Status key: ✅  Consistent · ❌  Conflict · 🕳  Gap/Stub · ❓  Needs
Clarification
Coverage marks:FULL = verified against the entire page · PARTIAL =
page was too long to read in one pass; only named sections checked.
🚧This is a living document, built section by section. See the Coverage
Report at the bottom for exactly which pages were fully read, partially
read, or not yet processed. Do not treat any category as complete unless
the Coverage Report says so.
How this page is organized
Findings are grouped by category, in the order: Locations →  Historical Figures
→  Noble Houses →  remaining categories.
Two running indexes live at the bottom: OPEN QUESTIONS and GAPS / STUB
ENTITIES.
A COVERAGE REPORT at the very bottom tracks what has and hasn't been
verified.
1. LOCATIONS
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
1
📄Subpage inventory: The LOCATIONS page LOCATIONS) has no child
subpages — it is one continuous page of 2,239 lines. The separate
canon pages MAPS/LOCATIONS and its map child are listed under the
remaining categories and are not yet processed.
Coverage: LOCATIONS page read in FULL. ⚠  Cross-page checks
against Historical Figures, Noble Houses, In-Story Characters, Religion,
Timeline, Magic System, the book-info pages, and the WWG branch are
PENDING. Unless another page is named in an entry below, every
"Conflict" listed is an internal contradiction within the LOCATIONS page
itself.
A. Cross-era / continental naming
Map eras — Status: ✅  RESOLVED  Consistent FULL — (was ❓  Needs
Clarification)
Facts found: The page presents the continent across three eras — Solis's Era,
Crandona's Era, and Minara's Era — with nations, capitals, and seas renamed
between them LOCATIONS, CONTINENTAL OVERVIEW sections).
Notes: Sea renaming is stated (e.g., Oberya Sea ↔  Orburydon Sea; Fetora Sea
→  "Thult Southern Waters"; the Mystic Isles →  "Thult"). These era chains
should be reconciled against TIMELINE, ERA'S REFRENCE, and the MAPS
pages once those are read.
✅  RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): The three-era renaming chains are
consistent and fully documented in the "Name Evolution Across Eras" / "Name
Evolution — Full Chain" sections of the map page THE SIX KINGDOMS
8,900BR  7,163 BR MAP. Confirmed territory chain: Aicruae →  Tanan Grand
Duchy →  Kingdom of Lajazer; Gherci →  Caporiolan Kingdom →  Kingdom of
Tarmet; Pireaynea →  Lingia →  Kingdom of Civer; Coelum →  Hikai →  Kingdom
of Atriki; Equateiy →  Uxridian Grand Duchy →  Kingdom of Ociyaran; Vikitsv →
Theolisseia →  Kingdom of Berlailia; Mystic Isles →  Thult →  Thult (no political
boundary). Seas: Oberya →  Orburydon →  Oberya (reverts by Minara's era);
Fetora →  Thult Southern Waters) →  Fetora (reverts); Quather unchanged
across all three eras; Henem Bay →  TBD →  Henem Bay. The sea renamings
originally flagged here Oberya ↔ Orburydon, Fetora → Thult Southern Waters,
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
2
Mystic Isles → Thult) are intentional, not errors. ⚠  Sole residual gap: Henem
Bay's Crandona-era name is still TBD] on the map page.
B. The Six Nations
Aicruae — Status: ✅  RESOLVED — population gap fixed FULL — (was: ✅
Consistent (minor population gap))
✅  RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): Eastern Aicruae's population is
corrected from "40,000" to 40 million — the original figure was a missing-digit
typo, irreconcilable with its canon role as the region with the "largest
unhoused and poor population in Aicruae." The national total is raised from
120M to 157 million, now fully itemized: four cardinal regions = 127M
Northern 20M  Eastern 40M  Western 65M  Southern 2M + a 30M
central/capital belt Lajazer 5M  Rewqo 10M  Jasereiey 15M. ⚠  Source
edits this implies on the LOCATIONS page (not yet applied): Eastern Aicruae
"Population: 40,000 people" →  "40 million"; Aicruae "Total Population: 120
Million" →  "157 Million" (and the flag write-up's "120 million people"); and
ideally add an explicit Central/Capital region entry so the 157M is itemized at
the source. Jasereiey's "TBD" region should be fixed to Central.
Facts found: Capital Lajazer LOCATIONS, Aicruae "Capital: Lajazer" and
Rewqo "just outside the capital Lajazer"). Currency Rern, ≈  20 USD. Follows
the Circle of Eternal Light. Regions: Northern Aicruae 20 million, "Also Known
As: The Northern Isles"; towns Aishae, Paler, Port Vento), Eastern Aicruae
("Population: 40,000 people"; town Haleker; borders Pireaynea), Western
Aicruae ("65 Million People"; food production), Southern Aicruae ("2 million
people"; prison territory; town Basar Tari).
Questions/notes: ❓  The regional populations do not sum to Aicruae's stated
national total — Northern 20M  Eastern 0.04M  Western 65M  Southern
2M ≈  87M, leaving a large remainder unaccounted for (no Central/capitalregion figure given beyond Rewqo's 10M. Eastern Aicruae's "40,000" also
looks anomalously small beside the others — confirm it isn't a missing-digit
typo.
Gherci — Status: ✅  RESOLVED — founding date settled FULL — (was ❌
Conflict)
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
3
✅  RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): Founding date corrected to 8,700 BR,
a year inside Saint Duri's lifespan 8,7478,670 BR — she founds Gherci as an
adult (~age 47 if born 8,747. Both prior dates were wrong: 8,763 BR (the
majority date — TIMELINE, Six Kingdoms map, KEY WORDS, Historical
Figures, Religion, LOCATIONS flag) sits 16 years before her birth; 8,663 BR
LOCATIONS prose + House Mava) sits 7 years after her death. Duri stays the
founder and her 8,7478,670 lifespan stays fixed; only the year moves. ⚠
Source edits this implies (not yet applied): change "8,763 BR" →  "8,700 BR"
on the TIMELINE, the Six Kingdoms map, KEY WORDS WARRIORS' AGE,
Historical Figures Saint Duri), Religion, the Proposed-Build draft, and the
LOCATIONS flag + Aryanara/Vekta entry; change "8,663 BR" →  "8,700 BR"
on the LOCATIONS prose and House Mava; and fill the LOCATIONS structured
"Founded: Date TBD" with 8,700 BR. The exact year is a soft placeholder
— sharpen it anytime.)
Facts found: Capital Tarmet. Largest/most populous nation, "389 Million
People," 78% female / 22% male. Theocratic monarchy; royal family is House
Mava but real power is The Teire (temple) led by the Main Master. Currency
Miuae, ≈  26 USD, "third most valued currency in the world." Epithet "The Land
of Eternal Silence." Founded by Saint Duri.
Conflict (founding year): "Gherci was founded by Saint Duri in 8,663 BR"
LOCATIONS, Gherci prose write-up) vs. "this ancient nation founded by Saint
Duri in 8,763 BR" LOCATIONS, Gherci flag description) and "Incorporated into
the Kingdom of Gherci by Saint Duri in 8,763 BR" LOCATIONS, Aryanara's &
Vekta's Territory). One section says 8,663 BR; two say 8,763 BR.
Conflict (structured vs prose): Gherci's structured BASIC INFORMATION says
"Founded: Date TBD Founder: TBD" even though the prose elsewhere on
the same page gives both a founder Saint Duri) and a date.
Questions/notes: ❓  The page contains two stacked Gherci write-ups (a
structured template + a prose version). They mostly agree but the foundingdate split above originates from this duplication. Recommend collapsing to
one.
Pireaynea — Status: ✅  RESOLVED — spelling settled FULL — (was ❌  Conflict
(spelling))
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
4
✅  RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): Canonical spelling is "Pireaynea." Every
cross-page mention agrees — the Six Kingdoms map, House Tazem (the
nation's only noble house), the Civil War map, TIMELINE  Proposed Build,
KEY WORDS AND TERMS, and A Tale of a Thousand Songs Characters ("Yera
of Pireaynea") all use "Pireaynea." The two "Pireayena" instances are
confined to this LOCATIONS page's Pireaynea flag prose ("Pireayena's
primary economic resource"; "the monotheistic Pireayena worship") and are
typos — a transposed -ayne-/-ayen-, not an alternate name. ⚠  Source edit
this implies (not yet applied): change both "Pireayena" →  "Pireaynea" in the
LOCATIONS Pireaynea flag write-up.
Facts found: Capital Civer. "Founded: 7,200 BR Founder: Deasn of Gherci"
(fled Gherci after a treason charge, "only 17 when he founded the country").
Population 67 million. Monotheistic worship of Allan only. Currency Brezeryiol,
≈  17 USD. Epithet "The Demon's Pit." Language "Pocorki." "renamed Lingia in
the new imperial order."
Conflict (nation spelling): Header/body spell it "Pireaynea"; the flag
description repeatedly spells it "Pireayena" (e.g., "directly reflects Pireayena's
primary economic resource"; "the monotheistic Pireayena worship"). Two
spellings on the same page.
Questions/notes: See the Civer entry Section F) for the capital-vs-province
cross-era question.
Coelum — Status: ✅  Consistent FULL
Facts found: Capital Atriki. Founder Yuavekio ("Yuavekio the Wise (an ironic
title)" / "a drunken explorer"); his debt "the nation never paid off." Currency
Opeali, ≈  5 USD, "Lowest valued currency known." Mostly atheistic. Epithets
"The Land of Sand and Time," "The Forsaken Land," "The Forsaken Place."
Surrenders "40% of any national earnings to Equateiy and Vikitsv." "renamed
Hikai in the new order."
Questions/notes: None internal. Cross-check the "Hikai" rename and 40%
debt against Equateiy/Vikitsv and the Timeline later.)
Equateiy — Status: ✅  RESOLVED — population settled FULL — (was ❌
Conflict)
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
5
✅  RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): Total population is 97 million. The figure
in the BASIC INFORMATION block stands; the "TBD" in the POPULATION
section was just an unfilled duplicate field and should be filled with 97 million.
97M is the only population number for Equateiy anywhere in canon — no
competing figure exists — and it sanity-checks cleanly against the other
nations Gherci 389M  Aicruae 157M > Equateiy 97M > Pireaynea 67M,
placing the small, wealthiest-in-the-world merchant state third in size. ⚠
Source edit this implies (not yet applied): change Equateiy's POPULATION
section "Total Population: TBD" →  "97 Million" on the LOCATIONS page.
Facts found: Capital Ociyaran. "Founded: 8,900 BR Founder: Yemaser of
House Kivier." "Unofficial oligarchy ruled by House Kivier." Currency Pel, ≈  50
USD, "THE HIGHEST VALUED CURRENCY IN THE WORLD." Epithets "The
Kingdom of Gold," "The Place of Sin," "The Land of Secrets."
Conflict (population): "Total Population: 97 Million People" LOCATIONS,
Equateiy BASIC INFORMATION) vs. "Total Population: TBD" LOCATIONS,
Equateiy POPULATION section). One section gives a number; the other leaves
it blank.
Vikitsv — Status: ✅  RESOLVED — spelling + leadership both settled FULL
✅  SPELLING RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): Canonical spelling is
"Vikitsv" (t-before-s). Confirmed despite "Vikistv" actually appearing in more
places by raw count — Vikitsv wins because it holds the authoritative slots: the
LOCATIONS official nation name, both maps Six Kingdoms + Civil War), the
Name Evolution Across Eras rename chain, and every Vikitsv noble house's
structured Origin/Seat field Orana, Leum, Renililas, Iriandet, Qari, Navefa,
Anasetanya, Miaran). ⚠  Large source edit this implies (not yet applied):
change "Vikistv" →  "Vikitsv" across the LOCATIONS flag/key-locations prose,
the Flags page, Historical Figures, Magic System, Houses
Patton/Kulio/Dajanyi, KEY WORDS, Language, Fashion Collections (incl. the
"Vikistv Fashion" subpage title), the book pages A Tale of Three Sisters, A
Tale of a Thousand Songs Characters + Book Info, A Princess in Love, A
Crown of Glory), and the "Noble Houses across the Eras" section heading.
Spelling + leadership now both settled — see below.)
✅  LEADERSHIP RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): One unified Grand
Sorcerer bloodline — no rival branches. The line runs Verna →  Liaerto I
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
6
Verna's eldest son) →  Ulian →  his sons Kiear & Liaerto III →  (through Liaerto
III →  Sevtor (the last Grand Sorcerer; House Orana; burned alive by Solis
7,217 BR; sole survivor Mekean Orana →  leads to Merigen Bleelack). This
makes Ulian a descendant of Verna via Liaerto I — which answers the open
KEY WORDS question ("Is Ulian a descendant of Verna?" →  yes), keeps House
Iriandet's "For Ulian" motto meaningful, AND preserves House Orana's canon
that it "descended from Verna's eldest son Liaerto I." ⚠  Source fix this implies
(not yet applied): the LOCATIONS "Magic Tower" passage saying "Current
Grand Sorcerer is child of Ulian's son Kiear" is wrong — the living line
continues through Liaerto III to Sevtor, not through Kiear; rewrite that passage
so Ulian / Kiear / Liaerto III sit inside the Verna →  Liaerto I →  … →  Sevtor chain
as earlier generations rather than as the current rulers.
Facts found: Capital Berlailia. Sits atop Mount Aicren, "COLDEST IN THE
ENTIRE KNOWN WORLD." Magocracy ruled by House Orana ("direct pure
breed line of Verna descent"). Currency Kis (gems), ≈  30 USD. Monotheistic
worship of Iswan (goddess of alchemy). The Magic Tower "Created by
descendants of Verna in 7,749 BR," holds 400 wizards. People have "blue
hair and blue eyes" and "Only wear BLUE articles of clothing."
Conflict (nation spelling): Spelled "Vikitsv" in headers/official name, but
"Vikistv" throughout the flag description and key-locations prose (e.g., "the
great sorcerer Verna who founded Vikistv"; "Torad is a small village located in
what was formerly known as Vikistv"; "The Silora Forest is a forest located
within Vikistv"). The Coelum flag also uses "Vikistv." Both spellings appear
repeatedly across the page.
Conflict Magic Tower leadership / Verna line): "Originally controlled by Ulian
and his sons Kiear and Liaerto III … Current Grand Sorcerer is child of Ulian's
son Kiear" LOCATIONS, Vikitsv MAGIC) vs. "Grand Sorcerer Sevtor (a direct
descendant of Verna's eldest son Liaerto I)" LOCATIONS, Vikitsv KEY
LOCATIONS / Valea). House Orana is also said to be "descended from Verna's
eldest son Liaerto I." So the page names two different current Grand Sorcerers
(an unnamed child of Kiear vs. Sevtor) and two different founding sons
Liaerto I vs. Liaerto III.
C. Aicruae regions & towns (all FULL)
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
7
Rewqo — Status: ✅  Consistent — "Region: Capital Region (just outside Lajazer),"
"Population: 10 Million." Site of "Battle of Rewqo 7,218 BR" Civil War Year Four)
where Princess Iris died; "Solis buried both Iris and later Orcus beneath a temple
of Nellebrie at Rewqo."
Jasereiey — Status: ✅  Consistent — "Population: 15 Million," "seat of House
Leva," "mineral mines"; "Battle of Jasereiey / Trench Warfare 7,221 BR" Civil War
Year One).
Bareta — Status: ✅  Consistent — "One of Orcus's three main strongholds";
"Massacre at Bareta 7,220 BR" Year Two); Mihel "lost his left eye" here.
Nyeo — Status: ✅  Consistent — second of Orcus's strongholds; Mihel "cost … his
leg" after Harnua's betrayal Year Two, 7,2207,219 BR.
Valea — Status: ✅  Consistent — Orcus's third stronghold; Solis nicknamed "the
Golden King" here Year Two, 7,220 BR; "Grand Sorcerer Sevtor of House Orana
attacks Valea using magic, killing 15,000 people" Year Five, 7,217 BR — matches
the Magic Tower section's "attack on Valea killed 15,000."
The Blue Tower — Status: ✅  RESOLVED  Blue Tower defined (was 🕳  Gap)
✅  RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): The Blue Tower is Aicruae's noble
counterpart to Basar Tari — a political holding cell for disgraced and
treasonous nobles, not a common prison. It sits in the city of Macerino,
slightly before (or within) the forest of Deyara, in the broader capital region
near Lajazer. This fits existing canon: the Aicruae NOTES describe noble
imprisonment as "often a political holding cell, not a punishment… but not
exempt from punishment either in cases of crimes like treason," with
"imprisonment in a tower" listed as a standard noble fate; the "Blue" reads as a
nod to Aicruae's national palette (the flag's blue = the Sky and the Sea).
Macerino and Deyara are new place names with no prior canon mentions, so
nothing is contradicted. ⚠  Source addition this implies (not yet applied):
expand the LOCATIONS "THE BLUE TOWER" entry from its one-line stub to
record (a) its function as the noble political prison, (b) its location — Macerino,
by the forest of Deyara, near Lajazer — and optionally (c) add Macerino &
Deyara as their own LOCATIONS entries.
Original flag: only "A prison for nobility within Aicruae, located near the
capital."
Canon Hyper Focused Audit
8
Note Civil War year/date spine — internally consistent): Year One = 7,221
BR, Year Two = 7,220 BR, Year Three = 7,219 BR (the Cidet attack), Year Four =
7,218 BR, Year Five = 7,217 BR. These line up. Verify against TIMELINE.
D. Sacred / neutral territories (all FULL)
The Cidet — Status: ✅  Consistent (internally) — temple complex; governed by
the council of priests; pilgrimage destination; attacked by Solis in Year Three
7,219 BR. Cross-check against Religion + In-Story Characters pending.
The Mystic Isles — Status: ✅  RESOLVED — alias + timeline settled FULL —
(was ❌  Conflict)
✅  RESOLVED (confirmed by Azora): Two threads, both now settled. 1 Alias:
canonical spelling is "Janrano Kiva" — the "Jonathan Kiva" instances are the
ones to fix (e.g., the LOCATIONS line "built his mercenary army… under the
alias 'Jonathan Kiva'" →  "Janrano Kiva"). 2 Coup → war timeline: no real

entries.title: Confirmed and Decided Hows
entries.text:
✅
Confirmed and Decided Hows
This page logs the "hows" pass for World Without God — the second grounding
sweep after the "whys" pass. Where the whys established why the godless world
hangs together, the hows establish how it actually runs: governance, money,
class, religion, war, family, time, sex, and the machinery of status. Everything here
was decided in one working chat. For each system you get: the gap (what was
unanswered), the pick (her exact choice, verbatim where given), how we got
there, and the agreed canon.
Method (how every decision was made)
Same technique as the whys pass. One system at a time:
Restate the gap — what the world hadn't yet answered.
Lay out the cited canon already on the books.
Offer 23 options, each passing the GRRM test (a clear CAUSE, a
COST/CONSEQUENCE, a WANT, and a WHYNOW/WHYTHEM, plus a "blend
/ rank by era" option and room for a custom answer.
She picks (a single option, a blend, or a custom era-progression).
I deliver paste-ready flat reference prose in her lexicon; she pastes it into
canon herself.
Ground rules held throughout: nothing is canon until she confirms; names are
drawn from her existing lexicon, not invented wholesale; tone is flat and dry, never
performative; cultures are inspiration, never copy Sinitic material culture with no
dragon motif and no obvious lifting); coined names are always flagged as
swappable.
Order of decisions
Confirmed and Decided Hows
1
Governance →  calendar, in this sequence: court governance →  capital court →
provincial machine →  succession →  surveillance/justice →  military →  money →
trade →  class →  religion →  material life →  knowledge →  health →  war →
communication →  family/inheritance →  calendar →  sex/courtship & the household
→  royal ranks & cross-branch rank →  bestowed titles (paused).
GOVERNANCE
1. Court governance — the leashes
Gap: How does the crown actually keep its great servants and nobles from eating
it alive?
Pick (verbatim):"Stack all three."
How we got there: Offered three rival mechanisms for binding power-holders
(hostage/marriage ties, rotation/term limits, and informers/audit). She chose to
stack all three rather than pick one.
Agreed canon — THE THREE LEASHES The crown holds its servants by three
overlapping leashes at once: 1 blood and marriage — heirs and brides kept near
the throne as living surety; 2 rotation — high office is term-bound and movable,
so no one roots into a post; 3 the watch — informers and audit running
underneath everything. No single leash is trusted; the redundancy is the system. A
man can slip one leash but rarely all three.
2. The capital court
Gap: What does the central government physically look like — offices, who sits
where?
Pick (verbatim):"a+B" — combine the two proposed structures; flat, simple
names only.
Options offered: A) a functional ministry government organized by department
and portfolio; B) a household / inner-court government organized around the
monarch's person and intimate service. She took both — hence the two rings
below.
Confirmed and Decided Hows
2
How we got there: Three rounds of naming corrections. Verbatim: "wtf are these
names. use simple names why are all the names metaphotic and overly stylized";
"the sacral court is too spot on … it should take inspo not be a copy"; "the writing
is still too performative." Lesson locked: flat dry prose, names pulled from her
lexicon.
Agreed canon — THE CAPITAL COURT Two rings. An Outer Court (the working
ministries) and an Inner Court (the household and the monarch's person). Named
offices, all flat: Seteri, Renhal, Piesten, the First Army and Second Army
commands, the Sevren, and the Esan. Court seat is Tarmet. Note correction:
"Supreme Inner Court Keeper," "Main Master," and "Lord Protector of the Temple"
are Teire Gherci religious titles, NOT imperial palace offices.
3. The provincial machine
Gap: How does the center actually rule the conquered six kingdoms day to day?
Pick (verbatim):"which using logic?" — she asked me to recommend the most
grounded option.
Options offered: A direct centralized administration (crown officials replace the
local lords); B indirect rule (govern through the existing houses); C) a hybrid —
indirect rule with a crown overlay. I recommended C, tied to the hard fact that the
kingdoms were conquered and the old houses demoted, not destroyed.
How we got there: When she asks for the logical pick, I make a decisive
recommendation tied to a hard canon constraint (the kingdoms were conquered,
old royal houses demoted not destroyed).
Agreed canon — THE PROVINCIAL MACHINE Indirect rule with a crown overlay.
The old royal and noble houses are left in place to administer their own lands
(cheap, and they know the ground), but a crown layer sits on top: touring
inspectors (the Veren) who circulate and report, and direct military governorship
imposed only on the kingdoms taken hardest by the sword. Carrot for the
cooperative, boot for the rest.
4. Succession
Gap: How does the throne actually pass?
Confirmed and Decided Hows
3
Pick (verbatim):"Designated heir."
Options offered: A strict primogeniture (the eldest inherits automatically); B
designated heir (the sitting monarch names the successor); C elective/council
succession (an heir chosen by a body). She took B.
Agreed canon — SUCCESSION The sitting monarch names the heir. Not strict
primogeniture, not election — designation, which keeps every potential heir
dependent on the monarch's favor until the last breath (and guarantees a
succession crisis whenever a monarch dies without naming clearly). The firstborn
is styled the Eclipsing Sun but is not automatically the heir.
5. Surveillance & justice
Gap: Who watches, arrests, and punishes — and how is the secret-police function
organized?
Pick (verbatim):"Crown swallows Council of the Forsaken."
Options offered: A) the Council of the Forsaken stays independent as a check
on the crown; B) the crown absorbs it into the throne's own apparatus; C) it is
abolished and replaced. She took B.
Agreed canon — SURVEILLANCE & JUSTICE The crown absorbed the old
Council of the Forsaken into itself, turning a once-independent body into the
throne's own organ of surveillance and enforcement. Justice runs through the
Esan (the law-code and tribunals) above board, and through the absorbed
Forsaken apparatus below it.
FORCE & MONEY
6. Military
Gap: What does the empire's armed force actually consist of?
Pick (verbatim):"AB" — combine a standing professional core with capped
noble levies.
Options offered: A) a standing professional army paid by and loyal to the crown;
B) a noble-levy system (houses raise troops on call); C) a mercenary/contract
Confirmed and Decided Hows
4
model. She combined A and B, with the levy caps acting as a leash.
Agreed canon — THE MILITARY A standing professional core — the First Army
and Second Army, roughly 200,000 between them — plus capped house levies
(nobles may raise troops only up to a fixed ceiling, a leash in its own right), plus
the absorbed Swords of Mertyeria. The standing armies answer to the crown; the
levy caps stop any house fielding a force that could challenge it.
7. Money & revenue
Gap: What does the empire spend and tax in?
Pick (verbatim):"Blend / rank by era."
Options offered: A) a single unified imperial currency; B multiple coexisting
currencies of differing value; C commodity/barter-based exchange. She
blended — multiple currencies coexisting and ranked, with the mix shifting by era.
Agreed canon — MONEY Six currencies in circulation, ranked by value: Pel
$50, Kis $30, Miuae $26, Rern $20, Brezeryiol $17, Opeali $5. The mix
and relative standing shift by era; the crown's authority over coining and
debasement is a lever of power in itself.
8. Trade & the underworld
Gap: How do goods, credit, and illicit money move?
Pick (verbatim):"Blend."
Options offered: A guild/charter-licensed trade under tight control; B freer
open markets; C) a state-monopoly model. She blended — licensed/chartered
trade above the line and an underworld beneath it.
Agreed canon — TRADE A blended economy — licensed guild and chartered
trade above the line (the Crown Merchant charter lets a commoner trader buy
quasi-noble standing, up to a Count-level ceiling), and a parallel underworld of
smuggling, unlicensed lending, and black markets beneath it. The two
interpenetrate; the crown taxes the legal layer and periodically raids the other.
SOCIETY
Confirmed and Decided Hows
5
9. Class & daily life
Gap: How rigid is the social order, and can people move within it?
Pick (verbatim):"Fixed estates, rare mobility from above."
Options offered: A rigid castes with no movement at all; B fixed estates with
rare, granted mobility; C) a fluid/open class system. She took B.
Agreed canon — CLASS Society is a set of fixed estates — you are born into
your order and ordinarily die in it. Mobility exists but flows from above: it is
granted (a bestowed title, a charter, a marriage approved by a superior), never
simply seized from below. The merchant who buys a Count's title and the
concubine's son who is elevated are both moved by someone with the power to
move them. Ranks: Peasants < Piesto < Knights/Dames < Ashanti < Counts <
Marquesses < Dukes < Archdukes < Royal, with Des/Der as royal kin.
10. Religion
Gap: In a world without a god, what is the religious structure and how does it
relate to the crown?
Pick (verbatim):"Two-power balance."
Options offered: A) a single dominant state church; B) a two-power balance
between rival religious institutions; C decentralized many cults. She took B (the
Circle and the Teire), with Goteivati later collapsing it into crown control.
Agreed canon — RELIGION Originally a two-power balance between the Circle
and the Teire — two religious institutions checking each other and the crown.
Goteivati III ended the balance: he crushed the Circle, seized the temples, and
folded religious authority under the throne, producing a Gallican-style
caesaropapism (church subordinate to crown) that persists to the present. The
two-power era is the "before"; the swallowed church is the "after."
11. Material daily life
Gap: What does the physical, lived world look like — dress, food, building, craft?
Pick (verbatim):"i like the material life of traditional chinsese without the dragon
motif and the overly obvious copying."
Confirmed and Decided Hows
6
Options offered: several real-world material-culture palettes to draw texture from
across the six zones. She chose a Sinitic base — as inspiration, never copy, and
without the dragon motif.
Agreed canon — MATERIAL LIFESinitic-inspired material culture across the six
cultural zones — but as inspiration, never copy. No dragon motif. Avoid any detail
that screams a direct lift. Take the texture (silks, tea, courtyard architecture,
calligraphy, porcelain, the aesthetic of restraint) and reskin it into her own world's
flora, houses, and names.
12. Knowledge & the Academy
Gap: How is knowledge — especially magic — taught, licensed, and controlled?
Pick (verbatim):"Blend."
Options offered: A guild/apprenticeship transmission; B) a central Academy
that licenses practice; C open/unregulated learning. She blended, centered on
the Academy as both university and licensing authority.
Agreed canon — KNOWLEDGE A blended system centered on the Academy,
which licenses the legal practice of magic and keeps the inheritance ledger
Article VII: bloodline-magic read to confirm legitimacy). Secular scholarship and
magical training run together; the Academy is both university and licensing
authority, which makes control of it a political prize. The Civil Exam is open to
noble sons only.
13. Health, medicine & death
Gap: How do people heal, and how do they die?
Pick (verbatim):"Secular craft medicine + rare elite magic-healing."
Options offered: A magic-healing common and central to medicine; B no
magical healing at all, pure craft; C secular craft medicine for all, with rare elite
magic-healing for the few. She took C.
Agreed canon — HEALTH Everyday medicine is secular craft — herbalists,
midwives, surgeons, physicians working by skill and accumulated knowledge, no
divine healing. Magic-healing exists but is rare and elite — expensive, licensed,
Confirmed and Decided Hows
7
reserved for those who can pay or command it. The ordinary person lives and dies
by craft medicine; the powerful buy the rare exception.
REACH
14. War & diplomacy
Gap: How are wars fought and peace brokered beyond the empire?
Pick (verbatim):"Blend."
Options offered: A conquest by force as the main instrument; B marriageand-alliance diplomacy; C mercenary/proxy warfare. She blended all three.
Agreed canon — WAR & DIPLOMACY A blend of pitched standing-army
campaigns, levied house forces, marriage-alliance diplomacy, and treaty/hostage
arrangements. The Crown Envoy carries the monarch's voice abroad. Force and
marriage are two faces of the same statecraft.
15. Communication & travel
Gap: How does information and how do people move across the empire?
Pick (verbatim):"Blend."
Options offered: A road-and-relay courier networks; B river and sea routes;
C beacon/signal chains (plus the question of whether magic carries messages).
She blended the mundane networks and kept magical communication rare.
Agreed canon — COMMUNICATION A blended network — imperial roads and
relay couriers (overseen by the Veren / the posts), river and sea routes, and a
beacon/signal-relay chain for invasion warning. Speed of communication is itself
a crown asset; whoever controls the relays controls how fast the center sees and
speaks.
FAMILY, TIME, AND THE BODY
16. Family, marriage, gender & inheritance
Confirmed and Decided Hows
8
Gap: How does descent, marriage, and inheritance actually work — and how did it
change over time?
Pick (verbatim, custom spine):"Other: It starts of as House by House patchwork
during six kingdoms era, solis era, conquest era, then it becomes cognatic and
House by House mixture, after the dark ages and during the damned emperor's
reign it bcomes Patriarchal primogeniture as the law all the way down to Minara's
era."
How we got there: She rejected the standard options in favor of a precise threestage historical progression, folding the matriarchal Matsiali in as a sub-layer of
the cognatic middle stage.
Agreed canon — FAMILY, MARRIAGE & INHERITANCE (three-stage spine):
Stage one — patchwork Six Kingdoms era →  Solis era →  Conquest era): no
single rule; each house follows its own custom for descent and inheritance.
Stage two — cognatic + house-by-house mixture (early/high empire):
descent can run through either line; the matriarchal Matsiali sits here as a
high point of female-line inheritance and women's power.
Stage three — patriarchal primogeniture as law (after the Dark Ages, under
Goteivati III "the Damned," down to Minara's era): the eldest son inherits, by
law, everywhere.
Throughout: marriage is a contract, not a sacrament (no god to swear before);
legitimacy is settled by the Academy's inheritance ledger reading a child's
bloodline-magic. The present patriarchy is "the youngest invention wearing the
mask of the ancient."
17. Calendar, festivals & time
Gap: How is time counted in a world with no god to date it from?
Pick (verbatim):"Civil calendar (crown owns time — regnal years, the Reset)."
Options offered: A) a religious calendar dated from a holy event; B) a civil
calendar owned by the crown (regnal years plus a secular Reset to year 0; C) a
natural/agricultural reckoning. She took B.
Confirmed and Decided Hows
9
Agreed canon — TIME, THE CALENDAR & THE RESET The crown owns time. The
calendar Reset to year 0 at Goteivati's secular re-zeroing (a French-Revolutionary
move — wiping the old religious count). Dates run BR / AR Before Reset / After
Reset). The Academy almanac fixes the official year (the year-name itself is
swappable), and documents are double-dated AR plus the regnal year of the
sitting monarch). Underneath the civil calendar, the old solar/Razar festival year
survives in rebranded or stripped-of-god form — the Circle and Teire holy days
were rebranded or abolished, though Agariso 21 survives. An agricultural year
runs beneath all of it.
SEX, COURTSHIP & THE HOUSEHOLD
18. Sex, courtship & relationships outside marriage
Gap: How does the society handle sex, courtship, and relationships outside
marriage, in a world where no god polices virtue?
Picks (verbatim):
Texture choice: "sex, courtship and relationships outside marriage, or art,
music, theater and leisure" (do both, starting here).
System choice: "Option A  B, Being a concubine and second wife is seen as
lesser than. We need to decide how the ranks in the household can go and
rules for the household..."
Options offered: A concubinage as a formal, legal institution (ranked, kept
women within the household); B) a courtesan/companion demimonde outside
marriage; C neither / informal only.
How we got there: She picked AB — Option A = formal concubinageand
Option B = the courtesan demimonde — with the hard social rule that being a
concubine or second wife is "lesser than." Then asked for household ranks, perclass caps, and the family hierarchy.
Agreed canon — THE HOUSEHOLD WIVES, CONCUBINES & RANK
Principle: one legal wife plus as many lesser women as rank and purse allow. No
sin and no vow polices it — only property and bloodline do, because only one line
Confirmed and Decided Hows
10
inherits cleanly.
Three tiers:
The Wife — one only, full contract and dowry, mistress of the household,
commands all other women; her children are the primary heirs. No two wives
at once; "second wife" is a courtesy term, not a legal one.
Concubines / lesser wives ("the lesser than") — taken on a concubine's
writ, no dowry (a one-time bride-gift at most), ranked by order taken and by
the wife's favor; they eat and sit lower, are dismissible, and their children are
legitimate-but-lower.
The demimonde — companion-women outside any household: no writ, no
rank, no claim. Influence but no protection; first to be purged whenever the
court wants a virtue display.
Floor: maids and servants hold no rank; unclaimed bastards likewise.
Per-class caps (sumptuary logic):
Emperor / royal: one empress + a capped ceremonial consort/concubine
ladder.
Royal kin Des / Archduke / Duke: wife + 34.
Marquess / Count: wife + 2.
Ashanti / knights: wife + 1 (if affordable).
Wealthy merchants: wife + 1 (sneered at as new money).
Commoners / peasants: one wife only; concubinage is unaffordable.
Family hierarchy: husband →  wife →  husband's mother →  senior concubine →
junior concubines →  unmarried daughters →  nurses/upper servants. The wife
outranks every concubine absolutely. Children rank by mother's tier first, birth
order second — the wife's youngest outranks a concubine's eldest, unless the
father elevates (the Solis mechanism).
Ledger & legitimacy: fixed by which woman bore the child and whether the father
claims it, confirmed by the Academy inheritance ledger reading the child's magic
against the registered father. A concubine's child carries the name and a marker,
cannot represent the house, and inherits behind the wife's children.
Confirmed and Decided Hows
11
Asymmetry (the maturity-dial point): a man's concubine is a sign of wealth; a
woman's affair is capital ruin — the B.W. ("Blood Whore") brand, affair-children
drowned. Nakedly about paternity, not virtue.
Era drift: Matsiali height (desire unpoliced, female-line, demimonde respectable)
→  high empire (ranked court concubinage, favored-bastard crises) →
Goteivati/Pataoiut (affairs made capital, the B.W. brand weaponized via the ledger,
women confined, demimonde driven underground) →  Restoration/present (the
hypocrite's paradox).
19. Women's ranks in the royal household
Gap: What ranks can a woman hold inside the royal household, and what comes
with them?
Agreed canon — ROYAL HOUSEHOLD RANKS
The Empress Queen — one only, the monarch's single legal wife; styled Her
Majesty, "the reflection of the moon"; holds the keys to the inner palace,
commands every other woman. Authority is positional, not affectionate.
The Dowager Empress Dowager / Queen Mother) — the monarch's mother;
often outranks the sitting empress in family matters; first candidate for regent.
The most powerful seat a woman can hold.
The consort ladder (below the empress, above the floor), each grade a legal
status with stipend, servants, and sumptuary rights: Noble Consort (senior;
sometimes styled "second wife"; her son can be named heir) →  High Consort
→  Consort →  Lesser Consort / Companion →  Palace woman (unranked).
Ascent by childbearing: the consort who bears the Eclipsing Sun (recognized
firstborn) can leap grades; "mother of the Eclipsing Sun" carries weight the
ladder alone cannot.
Precedence note (canon-anchored): consorts rank below the trueborn heirs
— a prince or princess outranks any consort who is not their own mother.
Princesses styled by birth order ("the first moon," "the second moon"); Des
kinswomen rank below the immediate family but above ordinary high nobility.
Extraordinary honorifics outside the ladder: Mother Superior of Aicruae (held
only once, by Isalian), Great Lady of House Patton, Mother of the Great
Confirmed and Decided Hows
12
Dynasty — prestige and precedence, no governing power.
20. Rank across households & branches
Gap: How do noble families with multiple branches rank wives and husbands
against each other?
Pick (verbatim, the rule she set):"the first legal wife of the first household should
outrank the first legal wife of the second household."
Agreed canon — CROSSBRANCH RANK (two axes):
Household seniority governs public precedence — the main line outranks
every cadet branch; a higher-titled house outranks a lower one.
In-house tier governs legitimacy and inheritance within a single line — wife
over concubine, trueborn over baseborn, always.
Consequences:
The wife of the head of house (the Duke) outranks the wife of his younger
brother who heads a cadet branch, though both are "first legal wives." The
main-line wife is the Lady of House X; the cadet wife is Lady of [her estate].
The Great Lady / dowager of the main line sits above all branch wives and
arbitrates disputes among them.
Where the axes collide: a senior household's concubine can take public
precedence over a poor cadet branch's legal wife — but never touches
inheritance, where tier governs the bloodline.
Husbands who marry in (uxorilocal, or marriage to a ruling woman) rank by
and below the wife, like a King Consort; their sons may carry her house's
name.
Moving between branches: marrying up raises you, marrying down lowers
you; a large enough dowry Isalian's was twice the royal treasury) buys
precedence above your natal station.
Tie-breakers (equal rank and tier): husbands' seniority →  wife's natal house
rank →  date of marriage →  number of trueborn sons.
Confirmed and Decided Hows
13
Era drift: Matsiali ranked households down the female line (husbands ranked
as consorts); Goteivati's Pataoiut flipped it onto the male line; the present runs
on patriarchal primogeniture, the main-line male's wife leading, his mother
above her.
21. BESTOWED & FLOURISH TITLES
(paused — in progress)
Status: Paused at her request. Logged here as the work stands. Target structure:
35 titles for men + 35 for women, each split 15 bestowed (power/office) + 15
flourish (reputation/status) + 5 spare. All non-hereditary, granted by the crown,
revocable, ending at death.
Confirmed keepers ( ✓ ) across rounds:
Bestowed: Lord Protector of March/Province], Keeper of the Esan, Crown
Envoy, Crown Merchant Purveyor to the Throne), First Lady of the
Bedchamber, Honored Companion of the Empress, Great Lady of the Court,
Master of Rites, Grand Marshal, Lord Treasurer of the Crown, Lord
Chamberlain of the Inner Court, Master of the Academy.
Flourish: Lady of Flowers and the Arts, First of the Ansari, Lord of Verse, Lord
of the Hunt, Lady of Virtue, Lady of Charity, Lady of Wisdom.
Working notes: flourish titles need not all be about the arts — simple
virtue/character titles ("Lady of Virtue") are wanted; titles should range beyond
court and arts (military, frontier, sea, trade, law, magic); under Matsiali women
held the power offices freely, Pataoiut stripped them toward flourish titles.
Men — current full list (working)
Bestowed 15 Lord Protector of March/Province] ✓  · Grand Marshal ✓  · Master
of Rites ✓  · Keeper of the Esan ✓  · Crown Envoy ✓  · Lord Treasurer of the Crown ✓
· Lord Chamberlain of the Inner Court ✓  · Master of the Academy ✓  · Crown
Merchant Purveyor to the Throne) ✓  · Lord High Constable · Lord Admiral of the
Crown · Lord Warden of the Frontier · Master of Waters and Works · Lord of the
Far Trade · Lord Steward of the Crown Lands.
